description: This file implements a stress testing utility for CPU and memory, designed to be used within Kubernetes environments. It provides command-line options to allocate memory and spawn CPU-consuming goroutines.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that parses resource quantities, logs info, and initiates CPU and memory stress functions.

methods.name: burnCPU
methods.description: Spawns goroutines to consume CPU by copying from /dev/zero to /dev/null.

methods.name: allocateMemory
methods.description: Allocates memory in chunks based on specified total and step size, with sleep intervals.
